images.author: Nyttend
images.caption: Front of the Culver Union Hospital, located at 306 Binford Street in Crawfordsville, Indiana, United States.  Built in 1929, it is listed on the National Register of Historic Places.

brief: Early-20th-century brick community hospital: a four-storey main block with a hipped roof and a central entrance, long wards in side wings and a later flat-roofed addition; lawn and ambulance drive in front. Record gap: 1 photo.

facade.notes: the old Culver Union Hospital (Crawfordsville IN, 1902): a four-storey brick hospital block with a hipped roof and gable dormers, striped metal window awnings, a columned entrance portico, a flat-roofed modern wing with curtain-wall glass; now empty, windows boarded, a parking lot with accessible spaces in front, fog

why.note: a small-town hospital closed when care consolidated into regional centres
